name: Triceratops
feature: Three horns on its face and a big bony neck shield
funFact: Triceratops had a parrot-like beak and up to 800 teeth for chewing tough ferns and palms!

name: Brachiosaurus
feature: Super long giraffe-like neck and front legs longer than back legs
funFact: Unlike most dinosaurs, its front legs were longer than its hind legs, helping it reach high treetops!

name: Stegosaurus
feature: Two rows of kite-shaped plates along its back and four tail spikes
funFact: Even though Stegosaurus was the size of a bus, its brain was only about the size of a walnut!

name: Ankylosaurus
feature: Tank-like bony body armor and a heavy club at the end of its tail
funFact: Ankylosaurus was so armored that even its eyelids had bony plates to protect its eyes!

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
feature: Giant jaws with banana-sized teeth and tiny two-fingered arms
funFact: T-Rex had the strongest bite of any land animal ever and a super sense of smell!

name: Velociraptor
feature: Feathered body, long stiff tail for balance, and a curved sickle toe claw
funFact: Real Velociraptors were covered in feathers and were about the size of a large turkey!

name: Spinosaurus
feature: Giant tall sail on its back and a long crocodile-like snout
funFact: Spinosaurus loved water and used its paddle-like tail to swim through rivers hunting giant fish!

name: Allosaurus
feature: Two small bumpy horns above its eyes and strong three-fingered claws
funFact: Allosaurus was the top predator of the Jurassic period, millions of years before T-Rex lived!

name: Parasaurolophus
feature: Long backward-curving tube crest on its head and a duck-like bill
funFact: It could blow air through its hollow head crest like a giant trombone to call to its herd!

name: Pachycephalosaurus
feature: Smooth, bowling-ball-like dome on top of its head ringed with small spikes
funFact: The bony dome on top of its head was up to 10 inches thick—like a built-in crash helmet!

name: Pteranodon
feature: Huge leathery wings, long pointed head crest, and a long toothless beak
funFact: Pteranodon was a flying reptile (pterosaur) with a wingspan wider than a small school bus!

name: Plesiosaurus
feature: Four wide paddle flippers and a long snake-like neck for swimming
funFact: Plesiosaurus flapped its four flippers like a sea turtle to glide gracefully underwater!
